rationale: The short thesis remains mechanically intact — price is still ~4.2% below session VWAP ($42.17), the bounce to $40.84 was rejected on the heaviest volume since entry (58.5k shares), and the 5m 9-EMA at $40.62 continues to cap rallies with SPY red and VIXY elevated. A break of the $40.13 day-low keeps the unfilled gap at $38.89 in play as follow-through, while risk stays cleanly defined at the $40.85 invalidation (~$132, well inside the remaining budget), so holding beats banking a small gain. Flipping long would be counter-trend against VWAP, the intraday tape, and the distribution structure, with only shallow higher lows as support for that case.
